name: ui-ux-pro-max-skill
tagline_zh: 还在为界面丑失眠？这个技能把设计系统装进AI，从配色到间距自动把关，连你漏掉的对比度都提醒，像有个挑剔的设计师坐你。
tagline_en: Sick of ugly interfaces? This skill injects design systems into AI, auto-checking color, spacing, even contrast.
desc_en: An AI SKILL that provide design intelligence for building professional UI/UX multiple platforms
why_zh: 同类只会给建议，它直接生成可执行的UI规范，并检查可访问性，把设计决策变成代码级约束。
why_en: Unlike generic advice, it outputs executable UI specs and audits accessibility, turning design decisions into code-level.
